author: /root/restart_checkpoint
claim: The actual reciprocal base has original Q(t) as fraction field under s maps to 1/t, with exact original full-field embedding square

obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.required_input: The reciprocal polynomial embedding must be injective and its denominator a unit in K.
obligations.constructed_input: inverse_transcendental proves X inverse transcendental; inverse_aeval_injective supplies the actual polynomial injection. All four twists are rational units.
obligations.justification: The localization lift uses the actual reciprocalDenominator_ne_zero, not a new nonvanishing assumption.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.required_input: The field must remain original Q(t), and the base its specified reciprocal open.
obligations.constructed_input: K=RatFunc Q and Base c=ReciprocalInfinityBase318.ReciprocalOpen c. L is the original full Kummer field.
obligations.justification: The s-line is not replaced by the ramified u-line, and no field is silently relabeled.

obligations.name: Coverage
obligations.required_input: The statement must hold on the entire localized base, for all unit twists.
obligations.constructed_input: actual_fractionField and original_field_square quantify over every c; original_field_value covers every base element.
obligations.justification: Polynomial generators determine the full localization maps by the genuine localization extensionality theorem.

obligations.name: Maps
obligations.required_input: Actual coordinate inversion and base maps must have their correct directions.
obligations.constructed_input: inversionHom is the rational-function extension of aeval(X inverse); twice proves both inverses of inversion. baseFieldMap maps the reciprocal open to original K.
obligations.justification: on_polynomial and on_coordinate compute the actual map, and original_field_square composes it with the original K to L inclusion.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.required_input: The reciprocal coordinate and rational constants must be exactly normalized.
obligations.constructed_input: s maps to t inverse, with all rational constants preserved. The existing reciprocalEmbedding_coordinate supplies this exact normalization in L.
obligations.justification: No scalar multiple or ramified u coordinate replaces s. Rational map compatibility is proved on constants, not assumed.

obligations.name: Identities
obligations.required_input: IsFractionRing must use precisely the constructed base algebra.
obligations.constructed_input: baseAlgebra is baseFieldMap.toAlgebra; actual_fractionField explicitly installs it and the reciprocal polynomial algebra with exact scalar tower.
obligations.justification: The polynomial fraction property is transported through the actual inversion ring equivalence and then through localization. Equality of underlying field types alone is not used.

obligations.name: Local/global
obligations.required_input: A generator identity must extend to the whole base ring.
obligations.constructed_input: original_field_square is equality of ring homomorphisms from the full reciprocal localization.
obligations.justification: It is proved by localization extensionality and polynomial constants/X, not by generic point or closed-point injectivity.

obligations.name: Evidence
obligations.required_input: Exact final sources need strict checks and recursive private-inclusive audit.
obligations.constructed_input: The final ReciprocalRatFunc318 passes its MODULE_EXIT=0 in check-4; the unchanged final ReciprocalBaseFraction318 passes check-6. audit.log freshly checks all27 declarations in both modules and six required endpoints.
obligations.justification: The later distinct source failure in check-4 and all earlier failed elaboration logs are retained honestly. No full-chain replay, no dependency download.

obligations.name: Boundary
obligations.required_input: Separate this helper from ramification and independent acceptance.
obligations.constructed_input: This author packet supplies actual fraction-field and embedding-square inputs to contact’s consumer.
obligations.justification: It does not itself prove infinity inertia, ramification index, prime existence, or a valuation restriction formula. Non-author consuming review and hosted integration are pending.
